title: Days Open shows whole days since creation and reads 0 days / 1 days
refs: SV-8660 (WIP spec v24 per Chris Ward 2026-08-19; Story 4 S4-R12 Days Open = whole days since the work order date,per job; two-row jobs share the number; no per-line ageing)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The report shows a work order created today, one created exactly one day ago, and one created several days ago..
steps:
1. Read the Days Open cell of the work order created today.
2. Read the Days Open cell of the one-day-old work order.
3. Read the Days Open cell of the older work order and compare against its creation date.
expected:
1. Days Open is the whole number of days since the work order was created - elapsed time divided by 24 hours, floored, never negative - rendered as "X days".
2. A same-day work order shows "0 days" and a one-day-old work order shows "1 days".
3. The value is NOT grammatically pluralized: "1 days" (not "1 day") is the correct, expected rendering.
4. Days Open is a property of the job, not the row. When a work order appears as two rows (its status tab plus Estimates), BOTH rows show the same Days Open number - the money splits by line state, the clock does not. This shared number is correct behaviour, not a defect.
5. There is no per-line ageing: an unapproved line does NOT age from its own line date. Days Open is always measured from the work order's date.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582 and the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (Story 4, S4-R12), as pinned and answered by Chris Ward on 19 August 2026, recorded in his answers in this file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bilalmuzamil-sketch/Manual-test-Cases/claude/slack-session-0sxnd9/build/report-suite/chris-answers-2026-08-19/WIP-CHRIS-RULINGS-2026-08-19.md.
Chris Ward confirmed on 19 August 2026 that aging is per job and final; the earlier stray specification line suggesting unapproved lines age from the line's own date is removed as of version 24, so no per-line ageing is asserted here.
Last checked against build v3.8-d0e135e on 8/19/2026.
